chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about liwat, and he said: “Between the thighs.”
He said: And I asked him about the one who penetrates, so he said: “That is disbelief in what Allah sent down upon His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.اللِّوَاطِ: liwat; the prohibited sexual act being asked about in this narration
key_terms.الْكُفْرُ: disbelief; a severe theological judgment used in the narration
key_terms.بَيْنَ الْفَخِذَيْنِ: between the thighs; the Imam’s concise description in response to the question
key_terms.بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ: in what Allah sent down; referring to divine revelation and ruling
key_terms.نَبِيِّهِ: His Prophet; meaning the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.يُوقِبُ: penetrates; referring to the one who performs the act of insertion

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about liwat and the one who commits penetration?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام addresses the legal and theological gravity of liwat. It distinguishes between acts associated with it and describes the one who commits penetration as falling into kufr with respect to what Allah sent down upon His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.
